view.scene_description: A wide-angle view of a large, well-lit warehouse interior with high ceilings and concrete floors. Multiple forklifts and pallets are parked or in use near tall metal racks filled with stacked boxes. Yellow safety barriers and numbered rack signs are visible. A person in red is seen walking in the distance. The space appears organized and operational.

objects.label: forklift
objects.observation: An orange and black STILL forklift on the left side of the aisle, facing forward. It has a black cab and visible branding. It is parked on the concrete floor, partially obscured by a yellow safety post. No visible attachments or cargo.

objects.label: forklift
objects.observation: Another orange and black STILL forklift further down the aisle to the left, behind the first one. It is also parked and facing forward. Its rear section is partially visible behind the first forklift.

objects.label: forklift
objects.observation: A gray and yellow forklift on the right side of the aisle, positioned near a pallet of boxes. It has a raised mast and appears stationary. Its front wheels are on the concrete floor, and it is adjacent to a yellow safety barrier.

objects.label: pallet jack
objects.observation: A metal pallet jack with a beige tarp covering its load, located in the center of the aisle. It has two wheels and is positioned between two forklifts. The tarp is draped over the top, obscuring the contents.

objects.label: person
objects.observation: A person wearing a red shirt and dark pants is walking away from the camera down the central aisle. They are small in the frame and appear distant, near the far end of the warehouse. Their exact actions are unclear due to distance.

objects.label: warehouse rack
objects.observation: Tall metal racks extending vertically along both sides of the aisle, filled with stacked cardboard boxes. The racks have numbered signs (e.g., '6' and '7') attached. They are supported by vertical beams and horizontal shelves, with some boxes visible at different heights.

objects.label: yellow safety barrier
objects.observation: A yellow cylindrical barrier with a black base, positioned on the right side of the aisle near the forklift. It is mounted on the floor and appears to be part of a larger safety system. It is partially obstructing the view of the forklift’s front.

objects.label: cardboard box
objects.observation: A stack of brown cardboard boxes on a wooden pallet, located near the gray forklift on the right. The boxes are arranged neatly and appear to be standard shipping containers. They are resting directly on the pallet, which is on the concrete floor.

objects.label: ceiling lights
objects.observation: Bright overhead lighting fixtures suspended from the high ceiling, illuminating the warehouse. They are evenly spaced and provide ample illumination across the entire area. Their exact shape is not clearly visible due to distance.

State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):

Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.
